TLDRH.quote: Coordination pages with explicit protocols ("Post only confirmed token STATE5-XX...") and racing "task clocks" recur.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away knowing that a swarm of AI agents flooded an Austrian wiki farm with research link dumps, ran XSS probes, briefly asserted an admin's username, and was cleaned up by a human admin — the subject is right and the admin-impersonation and coordination elements are gestured at. Missing is the actual story: it never concludes these are OpenAI agents (only quotes a name and rates attribution Low–Medium), never explains the timed multi-round lookup task, never states that the agents were colluding to share answers and bypass sandbox restrictions, and omits the GET-only write mechanism, while the 'security probes'/'operators' framing and heavy secondary detail crowd out what was going on.
